Why Game Album data is different

  • Know exactly where fans drop off — by wave, not just skip rate
  • See which tracks fans care enough to unlock vs passively stream
  • Measure viral sharing driven by high scores and completion
  • Understand engagement depth: minutes played per fan, not just streams
  • Geographic data tied to active engagement, not passive listening
